"""Camera-guided controller for the single ThawInSink service episode.
Only RGB/depth calibration and robot proprioception are used.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np, json, os, argparse
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
ROOT='/app/runs'
CAMS=['robot0_agentview_center','robot0_agentview_right','robot0_eye_in_hand','robot0_agentview_left']

def state(m):
 p=m['proprio'];return dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))
def joints(m):
 s=state(m);return np.array([s[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1,8)])
def ee(m):
 s=state(m);return np.array([s[f'eef_right_{x}'] for x in 'xyz'])
def pose(m):
 T=np.array(m['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl']);T[:3,3]=ee(m);return T

def fk(q):
 # Standard Panda modified DH geometry, a model of the robot only.
 a=[0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088];d=[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,0];al=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
 T=np.eye(4)
 for qi,ai,di,ali in zip(q,a,d,al):
  ca,sa=np.cos(ali),np.sin(ali);c,s=np.cos(qi),np.sin(qi)
  T=T@np.array([[c,-s,0,ai],[s*ca,c*ca,-sa,-di*sa],[s*sa,c*sa,ca,di*ca],[0,0,0,1]])
 return T

def transform(x):
 T=np.eye(4);T[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[:3]).as_matrix();T[:3,3]=x[3:];return T

def fit(paths):
 ms=[json.load(open(p+'/meta.json')) for p in paths]; fs=[fk(joints(m)) for m in ms];ts=[pose(m) for m in ms]
 def res(x):
  B=transform(x[:6]);E=transform(x[6:]);out=[]
  for f,t in zip(fs,ts):
   v=B@f@E;out.extend((v[:3,3]-t[:3,3]));out.extend(Rotation.from_matrix(v[:3,:3]@t[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec()*.3)
  return out
 x=np.zeros(12);x[3:6]=[1.9,-3.2,.9];x[11]=.21
 opt=least_squares(res,x,max_nfev=4000);print('fit residual',np.linalg.norm(opt.fun),'params',opt.x)
 np.savez('/app/output/kinematics.npz',B=transform(opt.x[:6]),E=transform(opt.x[6:]))
 return opt

class Control:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot();self.n=int(open('/app/output/count').read()) if os.path.exists('/app/output/count') else 0
  self.m=self.r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='none').meta
 def save(self,o,note):
  self.n+=1;p=f'{ROOT}/{self.n:03d}_{note}';o.save(p);open('/app/output/count','w').write(str(self.n));open('/app/output/latest','w').write(p);self.m=o.meta
  print(p,'ee',ee(self.m),'q',joints(self.m),'grip',state(self.m)['gripper0_right_finger_joint1_pos'],'time',self.m['time_left_s']);return p
 def move(self,q=None,grip=None,seconds=2,base=None,torso=0,note='move'):
  s=state(self.m);q0=joints(self.m);q=q0 if q is None else np.array(q);g=s['cmd_grip'] if grip is None else grip
  n=round(seconds/.05);qs=q0+(q-q0)*np.linspace(0,1,n)[:,None]
  A=np.zeros((n,13));A[:,:7]=qs;A[:,7]=g;A[:,12]=-1
  if base is not None:A[:,8:11]=base;A[:,12]=1
  A[:,11]=torso
  o=self.r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='none',note=note);return self.save(o,note)
 def goto(self,p,R=None,seconds=3,grip=None,note='goto'):
  k=np.load('/app/output/kinematics.npz');B=k['B'];E=k['E'];q0=joints(self.m)
  # Align model with present measured hand pose, absorbing base/torso displacement.
  B=pose(self.m)@np.linalg.inv(fk(q0)@E)
  if R is None:R=pose(self.m)[:3,:3]
  def res(q):
   t=B@fk(q)@E
   return np.r_[t[:3,3]-p,Rotation.from_matrix(t[:3,:3]@R.T).as_rotvec()*.3,(q-q0)*.0003]
  lower=np.array([-2.89,-1.76,-2.89,-3.07,-2.89,-.017,-2.89]);upper=np.array([2.89,1.76,2.89,-.07,2.89,3.75,2.89])
  opt=least_squares(res,np.clip(q0,lower,upper),bounds=(lower,upper),max_nfev=600)
  print('IK',opt.x,'res',res(opt.x)[:6])
  if np.linalg.norm(res(opt.x)[:3])>.025:raise ValueError('Unreachable target')
  return self.move(opt.x,grip,seconds,note=note)

if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('cmd');ap.add_argument('values',nargs='*',type=float);ap.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=2);ap.add_argument('--grip',type=float);ap.add_argument('--note',default='move');args=ap.parse_args()
 c=Control()
 if args.cmd=='obs':c.save(c.r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='none'),'obs')
 if args.cmd=='joint':c.move(args.values,grip=args.grip,seconds=args.seconds,note=args.note)
 if args.cmd=='delta':c.move(joints(c.m)+np.array(args.values),grip=args.grip,seconds=args.seconds,note=args.note)
 if args.cmd=='base':c.move(base=args.values,seconds=args.seconds,note=args.note)
 if args.cmd=='torso':c.move(torso=args.values[0],seconds=args.seconds,note=args.note)
 if args.cmd=='xyz':c.goto(np.array(args.values),seconds=args.seconds,grip=args.grip,note=args.note)
 if args.cmd=='down':
  # Camera -z points down; camera +y points world +x.
  R=np.array([[0,1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,1]])
  c.goto(np.array(args.values),R,seconds=args.seconds,grip=args.grip,note=args.note)
PY
